model.correction_heads: composition vector on the element basis -> one hidden tanh layer -> zero-initialised output; bounded by exp(+-beta tanh)
model.optimizer: Adam, two stages (kernel-only, then joint); physical prefactors re-optimised in every training fold; double precision; no restarts

grouped_validation.tables: grouped cross-validation (Borg and HADEX), repeated-protocol calibration and conformal, held-out alloys, volume stability, mass balance

calibration_and_conformal.tables: calibration table, reliability figure, 20-split conformal table and verification figure

beta_sweep.tables: beta sweep under formula-grouped CV; selection by out-of-fold MAE
beta_sweep.settings: each analysis swept at its own width/schedule; selected beta listed above

beta_selection: out-of-fold MAE of the effective-volume arm under formula-grouped five-fold cross-validation on the 93 room-temperature Borg rows
historical_rng: Initialisation RNG state was not saved. Archived predictions reproduce tables; new refits use explicit seeds and are not bitwise replicas.
